description: This file defines a Thumbnail widget class for Flutter, along with helper classes ThumbnailSizing and ThumbnailProvider. It provides functionality to compute cache sizes for thumbnails based on layout constraints and device pixel ratio, and implements a customizable thumbnail widget that supports placeholder, error handling, and lazy loading.

classes.name: ThumbnailSizing
classes.description: A simple data class holding cache width and height for thumbnails.

classes.name: ThumbnailProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to compute cache sizes based on layout constraints, pixel ratio, and aspect ratio.

classes.name: Thumbnail
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing a thumbnail image, with support for placeholders, error UI, lazy loading, and aspect ratio constraints.

methods.name: computeFromConstraints
methods.description: Calculates cache width and height for thumbnails based on layout constraints, device pixel ratio, and aspect ratio.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Factory method to create a Thumbnail widget with options for image source, placeholder, error widget, and lazy loading.
